name: Khujand

queries.query: Khujand Tajikistan cadastral map parcel registry official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Tajikistan Geoportal and the State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy. The Geoportal describes public maps with location, cadastral number, parcel boundaries, geometry, and related objects. No anonymous parcel vector response with a safe native ID and full geometry was verified.

queries.query: Хуҷанд Тоҷикистон кадастр харита қитъаи замин расмӣ
queries.result: Official Tajik-language discovery identified the Geoportal, State Committee material, and an official 2026 report stating that digital cadastral maps are in use in Khujand and other Sughd regional registration organizations. This establishes local cadastral activity but not an anonymously accessible parcel API or safe retained geometry.

registryEvidence: The official Geoportal is a national public cadastral/map portal, and the official Khovar report says digital cadastral maps are operating in Khujand. The sources evidence a national custodian and Khujand cadastral activity, but no local public registry endpoint, anonymous parcel schema, or qualified parcel geometry was verified.
uncertainty: The Geoportal may expose parcel layers through a browser workflow or a service not reachable under the current certificate state. HTTPS access from the research environment failed certificate verification because geoportal.tj presented an expired certificate; HTTP redirected to HTTPS. The web reader also timed out opening the portal. These outcomes are not treated as citywide absence. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification exception was used. Packet completion is research completion only, not source integration or runtime admission.
